threats.title: Forged or replayed JWT (alg=none) presented to the API
threats.description: Forged or replayed JWT (alg=none) presented to the API
threats.mitigation: Pin RS256; validate iss, aud, exp; short token TTL

threats.description: JWT claims tampered; weak signature verification
threats.mitigation: Verify signature against Auth0 JWKS; reject unsigned tokens

threats.description: API calls not attributable to a specific agent and user
threats.mitigation: Log sub, azp, agent_id and endpoint on every request

threats.description: Verbose errors or logs leak tokens and data

threats.description: Runaway agent loop floods the API

threats.title: User-level token (read:ai-data) accepted on admin endpoint
threats.description: User-level token (read:ai-data) accepted on admin endpoint
threats.mitigation: Per-route scope check; return 403 when write:admin is missing

threats.description: Key exfiltrated through prompt injection or logs
